story.title: Wikido
story.text: [[Wikido]] (Wiki道) is the practice of wiki. It is an intentional play on aikido (合気道), the practice of aiki. Consider cross-language wordplay: English "do" and Japanese "do" (道) and Chinese Dao (道). This activity invites participation.

item.title: How To Wiki

item.text: Wiki is a hypertext. When you click a link you will go to that page. Here we have arranged the pages like rooms in an adventure game. There are things you can do here but you can just zoom through without doing any of them. Then maybe you will play again and do some things. Play it lots of times. You will get good at it.
